title: dashboard.update
description: Update existing dashboards. The dashboardid property must be specified for each dashboard, all other properties are optional; only the specified properties will be updated.

dashboardid.description: ID of the dashboard to update.

private.description: Type of dashboard sharing. Possible values: 0 - public dashboard; 1 - (default) private dashboard.

display_period.description: Default page display period (in seconds). Possible values: 10, 30, 60, 120, 600, 1800, 3600. Default: 30.

auto_start.description: Auto start slideshow. Possible values: 0 - do not auto start slideshow; 1 - (default) auto start slideshow.

pages.description: Dashboard pages to replace the existing dashboard pages. Dashboard pages are updated by the dashboard_pageid property. New dashboard pages will be created for objects without dashboard_pageid property and the existing dashboard pages will be deleted if not reused. Dashboard pages will be ordered in the same order as specified. Only the specified properties of the dashboard pages will be updated. At least one dashboard page object is required for pages property.

dashboard_pageid.description: ID of the dashboard page. Omit to create a new page.

name.description: Dashboard page name. Default: empty string.

display_period.description: Dashboard page display period (in seconds). Possible values: 0, 10, 30, 60, 120, 600, 1800, 3600. Default: 0 (will use the default page display period).

widgets.description: Array of the dashboard widget objects.

widgetid.description: ID of the dashboard widget. Omit to create a new widget.

type.description: Type of the dashboard widget. Possible values: actionlog - Action log; clock - Clock; (deprecated) dataover - Data overview; discovery - Discovery status; favgraphs - Favorite graphs; favmaps - Favorite maps; geomap - Geomap; graph - Graph (classic); graphprototype - Graph prototype; hostavail - Host availability; item - Item value; map - Map; navtree - Map Navigation Tree; plaintext - Plain text; problemhosts - Problem hosts; problems - Problems; problemsbysv - Problems by severity; slareport - SLA report; svggraph - Graph; systeminfo - System information; tophosts - Top hosts; trigover - Trigger overview; url - URL; web - Web monitoring.

x.description: A horizontal position from the left side of the dashboard. Valid values range from 0 to 23.

y.description: A vertical position from the top of the dashboard. Valid values range from 0 to 62.

width.description: The widget width. Valid values range from 1 to 24.

height.description: The widget height. Valid values range from 2 to 32.

view_mode.description: The widget view mode. Possible values: 0 - (default) default widget view; 1 - with hidden header;

fields.description: Array of the dashboard widget field objects. Required for specific widgets; see individual widgets in Dashboard widget fields.

type.description: Type of the widget field. Possible values: 0 - Integer; 1 - String; 2 - Host group; 3 - Host; 4 - Item; 5 - Item prototype; 6 - Graph; 7 - Graph prototype; 8 - Map; 9 - Service; 10 - SLA.

name.description: Widget field name. Possible values: see Dashboard widget fields.

value.description: Widget field value depending on the type. Possible values: see Dashboard widget fields.

users.description: Dashboard user shares to replace the existing elements.

items.description: Dashboard user object. List of dashboard permissions based on users.

permission.description: Type of permission level. Possible values: 2 - read only; 3 - read-write.

userGroups.description: Dashboard user group shares to replace the existing elements.

items.description: Dashboard user group object. List of dashboard permissions based on user groups.

permission.description: Type of permission level. Possible values: 2 - read only; 3 - read-write.
